description: ENYSTAR_Tuergriff is the drawing identifier for enclosure installation accessory in Hensel's ENYSTAR enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An enclosure installation accessory helps mount, close or organise the selected enclosure assembly. The component drawing does not describe a complete enclosure or certify an assembled installation.

For example, in a control-cabinet installation where an accessory joins the enclosure to its support, use the ENYSTAR_Tuergriff reference to coordinate accessory fixings, enclosure interface and installation access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as ENYSTAR_Zubehör/ENYSTAR_Tuergriff.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
